verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents running evals on every pull request in CI/CD. It also ships the `bt` CLI and a `npx braintrust eval` command that authenticates through a `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY` environment variable, plus a programmatic API, so it can run non-interactively in automation pipelines. missing for 10: a detailed CI setup guide (e.g., an official CI action or pipeline config example), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Automate in CI/CD — Run evals on every pull request to catch regressions
Run them from code or in the UI, track progress over time, and integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production.
lets you run experiments programmatically, and lets you integrate evals into your CI/CD pipeline

`bt` is the command-line interface for Braintrust. It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
